You're investigating a git branch in the repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover (design-to-code handover repo for client Zimmermann, component tag prefix `zimm-`). Working directory is already checked out on branch `feature/browser-preview-and-full-kit-catalog`; `main` also exists locally, up to date with origin. READ-ONLY investigation: do not edit files, do not switch branches, do not commit. You MAY run the local preview server briefly to check it starts, but kill it afterward and don't leave background processes running.

Background: this branch adds local dev infrastructure and a new catalog page, and separately had to merge in 6 commits of unrelated design work from `main` partway through (a real merge, with conflicts) plus fix breakage that merge caused. Four things to verify, from these commits:

COMMIT 70e2982 "Add npm start for local preview, no dependencies": adds server.js, a claimed ~50-line static file server using ONLY Node's built-in http/fs/path modules (no npm install, no node_modules, no dependencies), wired up as `npm start` via package.json. Claims: correct MIME types for html/css/js/md, 404 on missing files, directory traversal blocked, and that it correctly serves the catalog and the new Full Kit page.

COMMIT 596f802 "Make component demos openable via file://, add Full Kit catalog page": adds a "UI Kit -> Full Kit" page to 02-design/catalog/index.html — every component in one scrollable page grouped by tier, each rendering its live demo.html inline, claimed to be contract-driven like the rest of the catalog with no duplicated markup. Also converts all library demo.html files from `<script type="module">` to classic scripts and swaps `import.meta.url` for `document.currentScript.src` so they're openable via file:// (Chrome blocks type=module under file:// as CORS).

COMMIT 6ece7d6 (final commit) also separately fixes 3 prototype templates that the earlier Shadow DOM migration had left broken: 02-design/prototypes/templates/main/index.html, product-listing/index.html, product-detail/index.html. Claims each was still using `<script type="module">` with no runtime.js loaded and no component CSS `<link>` tags, AND each was separately missing 3-4 component `<script>` tags entirely for components used in its markup or composed internally.

COMMIT f6c9b38 "Merge remote-tracking branch origin/main into feature/browser-preview-and-full-kit-catalog": a real merge pulling in 6 commits / 15 new components from main, with conflicts in exactly 3 files: 02-design/library/elements/footer/demo.html, 02-design/library/elements/navigation/demo.html, 02-design/library/elements/product-card/demo.html. Note: product-card does not appear in the current component list in 05-handover/index.md on main (it was removed in a later main commit per main's own git log, "product-card removed") — check whether that removal is reflected consistently on this branch too, i.e. whether product-card still exists as a stray leftover anywhere after the merge.

YOUR JOB:
1. Read server.js in full. Confirm: actual line count is roughly ~50 (report the real number), it imports only http/fs/path (or other Node built-ins) with zero third-party requires, it sets correct Content-Type for at least .html/.css/.js/.md, it returns 404 for missing files, and it actually guards against directory traversal (e.g. `../` path escaping the served root) — quote the relevant guard code. Read package.json and confirm the `start` script and confirm there's no `dependencies`/`devDependencies` block (or that it's empty).
2. Try actually starting it: `cd /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover && node server.js &` (or via `npm start &`), then `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:<port>/02-design/catalog/index.html` (check server.js or its startup print for the actual port), then kill the background process. Report whether it actually served a 200. Also hit a nonexistent path and confirm you get a 404.
3. Read the Full Kit page implementation in 02-design/catalog/index.html (grep for "Full Kit" or similar to locate it). Confirm it's genuinely contract-driven (reads from 02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js dynamically) rather than a hardcoded list, and confirm it groups components by tier (atom/molecule/organism).
4. For each of the 3 prototype template index.html files (main, product-listing, product-detail under 02-design/prototypes/templates/), run `git diff main..HEAD -- <file>` and confirm: runtime.js is now loaded, component CSS `<link>` tags were added, and count how many additional `<script>` tags for components got added that weren't there on main (list which components). Sanity check at least one against the actual markup in that same file to confirm every custom element tag used (`<zimm-*>`) in the HTML now has a corresponding script tag loading its renderer.
5. Confirm how the 3 merge conflicts in f6c9b38 were actually resolved: `git show f6c9b38 -- 02-design/library/elements/footer/demo.html 02-design/library/elements/navigation/demo.html 02-design/library/elements/product-card/demo.html`. Also check `git log --all --oneline -- '**/product-card/**'` and `find /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover -iname '*product-card*'` on the current HEAD to determine whether product-card is fully gone from this branch (matching main's removal) or whether a stray file/reference survived the merge.

Report back with clear verdicts per claim, concrete evidence, under 550 words, verdicts first. Flag prominently if product-card leftovers exist or if the server/prototype fixes don't actually hold up when tested live.

=== commit message for 70e2982 (full body) ===
Add npm start for local preview, no dependencies

The catalog, prototype viewer, and IA viewer need a local server (they
fetch/dynamically import at runtime, blocked under file://), and until
now the only options were VS Code's Live Server extension or a manually
typed python/npx command. Added server.js: a ~50-line static file server
using only Node's built-in http/fs/path modules, wired up as `npm start`.
No npm install, no node_modules, consistent with the rest of the repo's
no-build-step approach. Prints all three URLs on startup.

Verified: correct MIME types for html/css/js/md, 404 on missing files,
directory traversal blocked, catalog and Full Kit page render correctly
against it.

Updated setup.html's "Preview locally" section to lead with npm start,
keeping the other three options as fallbacks for teams without Node.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

=== commit message for 596f802 ===
Make component demos openable via file://, add Full Kit catalog page

Library element demo.html files used <script type="module">, which Chrome
blocks under file:// as CORS. Five components also used import.meta.url to
locate their own assets/ folder, only valid inside modules. Neither was
needed: no element JS uses import/export. Converted all demo.html script
tags to classic scripts and swapped import.meta.url for
document.currentScript.src, so devs can open a component's demo.html
straight from Finder/Explorer with no local server.

Updated the /extract and /start-prototype skill templates so future
extractions and prototypes follow the same classic-script convention by
default.

Added a "UI Kit -> Full Kit" page to the component catalog: every
component in one scrollable page, grouped by tier, each rendering its
live demo.html inline. Contract-driven like the rest of the catalog, no
duplicated markup. The catalog itself still needs a local server (runtime
fetch + dynamic import of the contract), documented in setup.html's new
"Preview locally" section along with why demo.html no longer needs one.

Also added .claude/skills/README.md documenting all 16 skills (command,
who runs it, mechanics, prerequisites, gotchas) for onboarding.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

=== commit message for 6ece7d6 ===
CSS dedup pass, fix broken prototypes, contract audit fixes

CSS dedup (start of the roadmap's dedup pass):
- Move zimm-button.css to library/tokens/buttons.css, imported by common.css
  alongside colors/typography/spacing. Button classes are reused directly by
  other components' own native markup, not only zimm-button's own renderer,
  so every page now gets them for free instead of needing a per-demo <link>.
  zimm-button.js (the render function) stays in its own element folder.
- Introduce --zimm-focus-ring composite token in colors.css; consolidate 9
  byte-identical focus-visible outline declarations across 8 components onto
  it (add-to-wishlist, banner, card-baseline, card-editorial, cat-links-aside,
  page-toolbar, toolbar-category, button's own three focus states).
- Correct common.css's trailing comment, which still described the
  pre-migration Shadow DOM architecture.

Fix 3 prototype templates broken by the earlier Shadow DOM migration (same
class of bug as the 4 library demos fixed previously): main, product-listing,
and product-detail all still used type="module" scripts with no runtime.js
and no component CSS links. Also discovered and fixed each one silently
missing 3-4 component scripts entirely (used in markup or composed
internally but never loaded), not just the module/runtime issue.

Fix the extract skill's own docs so future extractions don't reintroduce the
composed-CSS gap: library.md's demo.html template and its composes rule only
described loading a composed component's script, never its stylesheet -- the
exact bug just fixed by hand across the library. Also fixed a stale path
(../../../common.css should be ../../common.css) in that template, and noted
that a token re-extraction must preserve common.css's buttons.css import.

Contract audit: wrote a script cross-checking every component's actual
attr()/bool()/slots.*/composed-tag usage against its contract entry rather
than trusting prior spot checks. Found and fixed:
- zimm-navigation: contract documented one generic menu-panel slot; the real
  implementation has 6 (mobile-utility + one named menu-* slot per nav item).
- zimm-text-input: trailing slot existed in code but not the contract.
- zimm-select: contract described a permanently-floated label that was never
  actually implemented (no <label> element exists).
- zimm-product-detail-gallery: contract described fixed 1200px/560px cell
  heights with a 4px gap; actual implementation uses aspect-ratio sizing with
  no gap, and always did, even pre-migration.
Each fix includes a dated correction note in the contract explaining what
was wrong, not a silent rewrite.

validate.mjs: 0 violations throughout. Audit script: clean after fixes.

### 1. server.js / package.json — CONFIRMED, with one inaccuracy
- **Line count:** 72 lines (`wc -l`), not "~50" as the commit message states. ~44% higher than claimed, though still a small single-purpose file. Flagging as a minor documentation inaccuracy, not a functional issue.
- **Zero dependencies:** only `require('http')`, `require('fs')`, `require('path')` (lines 9-11). `package.json` has no `dependencies`/`devDependencies` key at all.
- **MIME types:** `.html`→`text/html`, `.css`→`text/css`, `.js`→`text/javascript`, `.md`→`text/markdown`, plus svg/png/fonts/etc. (lines 16-33).
- **404:** confirmed live and in code (`fs.readFile` error → `res.writeHead(404, ...)`, lines 52-56).
- **Traversal guard** (lines 39-44):
```js
if (!filePath.startsWith(ROOT)) {
  res.writeHead(403);
  res.end('Forbidden');
  return;
}
```
Works because `path.join(ROOT, urlPath)` normalizes `../` sequences before the check runs. Minor latent weakness: it's a raw string `startsWith` with no separator boundary, so a sibling directory literally named e.g. `Zimmermann-Handover-x` would falsely pass. Not exploitable here (checked `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/`, no such sibling exists) — noting for completeness only.

### 2. Live server test — CONFIRMED
